# Trace fixtures

Labelled sample traces for `lib/zh/trace.ts`, one file per character (named by code point).
Generated by `npx tsx scripts/make-trace-fixtures.ts` from Make Me a Hanzi medians with seeded jitter,
**not recorded by hand**. See the script for the labels. Add traces recorded on phones and tablets
(as `samples` with the same shape) before tuning the thresholds further.
